# B"H — 01 — Runtime Contract Map

Every repair below must honor these contracts. A contract change is allowed only
if every consumer is traced first (source law).

## Data identity contract (DB → API → semantic model → renderer → UI)

- DB record for ikar: id, name, title, author, createdAt. THERE IS NO
  description field — never assume one, never render a placeholder that
  pretends to be data. Absence gets an elegant quiet state, not fabrication.
- API: `GET /api/social/heichelos/ikar` → the record;
  `GET /api/social/heichelos/ikar/series` → series list
  (The Written Torah, The Oral Torah).
- Client builds a semantic model (normalized; must include `semantic`) and the
  renderer paints UI from it. Pipeline is one-way; UI never invents fields.
- Presentation NEVER hard-codes "The Entire Torah" — it renders the title from
  the payload. Same for every series/post title, count, and timestamp.

## Boot chain contract (Phase 0)

- Order: `critical-boot.js` → `ikar-stable.js` → `ikar-first.js`.
- `bootIkarFirst` MUST be a callable function exported through this chain.
  The current breakage is exactly this export contract being violated.
- First-light contract: `semantic` must exist in the document BEFORE the first
  paint that reads it; `#heichel-boot-title` and the discovery list hydrate
  from the semantic model, never from literals.

## Auto-scroll contract (reader)

- Start = immediate continuous motion. No countdown, no ramp-up ceremony.
- Stop = stop and STAY stopped. No phantom restarts, no drift.
- Measure the REAL scroll vessel (the element that actually scrolls in a real
  post), never a window proxy or a guessed container.
- Interval measurement must be proven in a real post vessel, in a real browser.

## CSS contracts

- Social styles live ONLY under `.awtsmoos-social-root`. Leaks are defects.
- Every stylesheet gets classified: ACTIVE / COMPATIBILITY / DORMANT / LEGACY /
  DEAD. No `!important` wars — specificity conflicts get resolved by scoping,
  never by escalation.
- Whole-site chrome (Heichelos focus, breadth track) renders from shared design
  tokens (see 05).

## Navigation contract (gating check)

- Global top nav is PERSISTENT and offers one-tap Home from EVERY route.
- Mobile: safe-area insets respected, touch targets ≥ 44px.
- Failing the one-tap-Home check on any route fails the whole track.

## Motion contract

- transform/opacity ONLY for animation; 60fps budget.
- Every animation ships a reduced-motion counterpart (stillness, not a lesser
  animation). Timid/washed-out default = defect.
- Shared motion language everywhere: staggered card entrances, tactile press
  feedback, route continuity (forward pushes in, back returns gracefully).

## Server contract

- `node index` on port 8080. NO watcher → restart after EVERY change before
  verifying. No build script; `npm run test:*` are the suites (headless node).
- Regression tests for auto-scroll do NOT exist yet — they must be NEW files.

## Release contract

- The dirty shared worktree (dd77276a2) NEVER deploys.
- Release = clean isolated worktree from fresh origin/main, exact file set,
  gates pass, commit, fast-forward push ONLY.
- Then `npm run bh` (`node scripts/bhRelease.mjs` — READ IT FIRST) on the
  remote SSH host, then verify public production in a REAL browser
  (public SHA verification).
